tests.name: The unit suite is green on head, including the unchanged privacy-journal.test.ts. A pass of TP-1 in the verify attestation covers the unit command only and claims no int run. The int scenarios below run in CI test:int on the same head and are judged from that run and from the diff: each name is one exact, unique string literal in the diff, and the CI test:int output shows packages/core/src/ops/deletion-journal-authority.int.test.ts and apps/web/src/server/auth/deleting-account-sign-in.int.test.ts passing with no skip and test counts that include them (the CI reporter prints only some test names, so a name is not required to appear in the output). Names: «privacy journal: a stale worker after reclaim writes no journal object and moves no pointer» (AC-1, AC-7); «privacy journal: a failing writer never deletes the verified object of another writer» (AC-2, AC-7); «privacy journal: a ready journal always has its encrypted bytes» (AC-2, AC-7); «privacy journal: the API path without a Job keeps its behaviour» (AC-3, AC-7); «privacy cleanup: a stale worker cannot move a completed request to needs_operator» (AC-4, AC-7); «sign-in: an account in deletion is soft-deleted, not hard-deleted, and keeps its cost rows» (AC-5, AC-8); «sign-in: a user with no account is cleaned up exactly as before» (AC-6, AC-8). The locked unit tests (privacy-journal, backup-crypto, auth gateway and auth deletion-stage) stay green in the unit run, and the locked int tests (priv media, backups, backup-native, privacy-composition, org-cleanup, signup, the two cross-account privacy tests, privacy-ack, privacy-voice, priv recovery, priv jobs, auth flow and auth deletion-recovery) stay green in the same CI run (AC-3, AC-9). AC-10 and AC-11 are judged from the diff and the report.
